title.narrative: Social dialogue and dispute resolution mechanisms are strengthened to improve governance of the labour market, workers' rights and industrial relations

description.narrative: The Labour Code 2019 has an advanced framework for improving labour relations. For effective implementation, ILO aims to support the Government and Social Partners in building an inclusive, stable, and progressive industrial relations system. The expected outcomes include more effective tripartite cooperation, stronger social dialogue and collective bargaining practices, improved compliance with labour laws and international labour standards, with a better mechanisms for labour dispute resolution. Under the approved 5-year's Decent Work Country Programme 2022-2026, the ILO focuses its support on the workers and employers in Viet Nam, as well as national and local government institutions involved in labour and employment. Trade unions, employers’ organizations, and other social partners also benefit from improved institutional capacity and technical support. Ultimately, the broader Vietnamese workforce and business community stand to gain from more harmonious labour relations and fairer working conditions.
